Comment: Sampler. Wan 2.1 recommended: EULER_SAMPLE_METHOD (CLI: euler).

Name: --scheduler → sd_sample_params_t.scheduler
Comment: Sigma schedule. Default works for Wan; only override if you know why.

Name: --steps → sd_sample_params_t.sample_steps
Comment: Denoising steps. Wan 2.1 1.3B sweet spot: 20–30. More = sharper but linear time cost.

Name: --flow-shift → sd_sample_params_t.flow_shift
Comment: Rectified-flow timestep shift. Critical for Wan: T2V 1.3B = 5.0, I2V 480p = 3.0, I2V 720p = 5.0. Wrong value → dim/dark output.

Name: --cfg-scale → sd_sample_params_t.guidance.txt_cfg
Comment: Classifier-free-guidance scale on the text prompt. Wan 2.1 sweet spot: 6.0–7.5.

Name: --img-cfg → sd_sample_params_t.guidance.img_cfg
Comment: CFG on the image conditioning (I2V/FLF2V only).

Name: --fps → SDGenerationParams.fps
Comment: Encoder-side fps only — passed to the MJPG-AVI muxer at write time, never to the model. The model itself is fps-agnostic.

Name: -o / --output → SDCliParams.output_path
Comment: Output path. The vid_gen muxer always appends .avi regardless of extension.

Name: -M / --mode → SDCliParams.mode
Comment: Picks the call target: VID_GEN → generate_video(), IMG_GEN → generate_image().
